entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I hope you can help. I'm trying to figure out a return, and the website is just so confusing. I'm not sure what I'm doing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, can you tell me a bit more about the item you're looking to return? What specifically is the issue?
It's a cycling jersey I bought a while back. It's just the wrong size for me. I finally tried it on for a real ride and it's just way too tight. I thought I could make it work, but I can't.
I see. So it's a sizing issue, not a defect with the material or anything like that?
No, no, the jersey is beautiful! It's just... I clearly need a bigger size. I was hoping to do an exchange, but I got lost on the returns page. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let's get this sorted out for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. Let me see... It's VF886-0119.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered about 60 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy.
Oh no, is that too long? I knew I should have done this sooner.
Not at all. According to my system, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. We can definitely process this for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid return label. You can send the jersey back for a full refund, or if you prefer, we can process an exchange for the correct size once we receive it.
Thank you so much, Charlie! You've made this so much easier. An exchange would be perfect. Thank you!
You're very welcome. The email should be in your inbox now. Just follow the instructions there. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
